segments.title_card:
首盘5比4
三次险情全部化解
segments.narration: 五比四的发球胜盘局，十五比四十，她先救下两个破发点。回到平分后，又化解第三个。接下来，才是她自己的第一个盘点。

quote.text:
Well, Iga Swiatek able to hold off the advances of Ann Li,
斯瓦泰克顶住安·李的冲击，

and the forehand holds up when it needs to.
关键时刻，她的正手顶住了。

Down the stretch, three break points saved
盘末挽救三个破发点，

and converts on her first set point.
首个盘点便成功兑现。

And Iga Swiatek out in front,
斯瓦泰克取得领先，

one of the great front-runners in women's tennis,
她是女子网坛善打领先的高手，

has a one-set lead in Wuhan.
在武汉先下一盘。

Lest we forget, there's a little revenge on the mind of Iga Swiatek as well
别忘了，她也想报马德里之憾。

for that Madrid performance where she had to beg out
那场马德里比赛，她中途退赛，

at three-love in the third set.
当时决胜盘0比3。

Looking to extinguish hope as she has the break and hold.
破发再保发，要掐灭对手希望。

That's now eleven in the last twelve points,
最近12分，她拿下了11分，

since going back to the third break point she faced
从她面对第三个破发点算起，

when trying to serve for the opening set.
那是首盘的发球胜盘局。
